movie.title: Werwulf
movie.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Set in 13th-century England, Robert Eggers' Werwulf follows a cursed medieval farmer fighting to protect his family as a ravenous beast terrorizes their isolated village.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In 13th-century England, a rural community is haunted by an ancient, predatory creature stalking the foggy countryside. A cursed farmer, struggling against a horrific fate inflicted upon him in childhood, attempts to protect his wife and family as local folklore becomes a brutal reality. Meanwhile, a relentless local beast hunter arrives to track down the creature before it consumes the entire settlement. As paranoia and superstition fracture the village, the line between man and monster rapidly dissolves.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Directed by Robert Eggers, Werwulf transports audiences to 13th-century England, where an isolated village lives in absolute terror of a ravenous beast lurking in the surrounding wilderness. The story follows a quiet medieval farmer who relocates with his wife and children to a remote settlement in hopes of building a peaceful life. However, his past returns to haunt him, unveiling a dire curse placed upon him during his childhood that manifests under the light of the full moon. As mysterious, violent attacks begin devouring local villagers, paranoia spreads rapidly through the terrified community. Enter a seasoned, ruthless beast hunter determined to track down and slaughter the creature at any cost. Distrust and religious hysteria turn the villagers against one another as they desperately seek someone to blame for the nightmare unfolding around them. While the hunter closes in on his prey, the farmer desperately fights to retain his humanity and shield his beloved family from both the monster within him and the wrath of the townspeople. Ultimately, as the full moon reaches its apex, a harrowing confrontation ensues where devotion, damnation, and instinct collide in a tragic struggle for survival.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Directed and co-written by visionary filmmaker Robert Eggers alongside Icelandic poet Sjón, Werwulf is a visceral medieval folk horror film set in 13th-century England. The narrative centers on an afflicted farmer (Aaron Taylor-Johnson) living in a remote rural village with his wife (Lily-Rose Depp) and children. When a predatory monster begins terrorizing the foggy countryside, ancient folklore manifests as a gruesome reality for the vulnerable settlement. As a relentless beast hunter (Willem Dafoe) leads a crusade to eradicate the threat, fear and religious fervor consume the isolated populace. Spoken in authentic Middle English, Werwulf explores themes of devotion, superstition, and the harrowing descent into monsterhood as a family desperately fights to survive the terror stalking their land.

story_structure.climax: Under the full moon, the terrifying transformation culminates in a desperate, violent clash between faith, the relentless hunter, and the monstrous beast within.
story_structure.conflict: A brutal, mysterious beast begins hunting along the countryside, threatening the community and casting a dark shadow over the farmer's household.
story_structure.resolution: In the harrowing aftermath, the tragic reality of damnation takes its toll, leaving irreversible scars on the family and the isolated community.
story_structure.introduction: In 13th-century England, a humble farmer lives a devout, isolated life with his family in a fog-drenched rural village governed by deep superstition and faith.
story_structure.risingAction: As paranoia and dread grip the settlement, a relentless beast hunter arrives while the farmer suffers horrifying physical and mental torments, wrestling with an emerging curse.

characters.name: The Cursed Farmer
characters.description: The central protagonist played by Aaron Taylor-Johnson who struggles with his inner torment and tragic affliction as he succumbs to a terrifying curse.

characters.name: The Farmer's Wife
characters.description: Played by Lily-Rose Depp, a devoted spouse torn between love and survival as her husband succumbs to the devilish creature within.

characters.name: The Hunter
characters.description: Played by Willem Dafoe, a hardened tracker who possesses knowledge of ancient folklore and serves as a relentless guide in hunting the beast.

characters.name: The Farmer's Daughter
characters.description: Played by Bodhi Rae Breathnach, an innocent family member trapped in the mounting horror and tension of her household.

characters.name: The Young Farmer
characters.description: Played by Vidal Arzoni, a local villager caught up in the paranoia and threat facing the community.

characters.name: The Beast / Werwulf
characters.description: The terrifying creature stalking the medieval countryside that embodies the dark curse plaguing the village.

characters.name: The Town Elders / Villagers
characters.description: Portrayed by Ralph Ineson, Ned Dennehy, Jack Morris, Jan Bijvoet, and Ritchi Edwards, representing the superstitious local community driven to mob mentality and paranoia.
